title: A reactivated part is offered again in every Add Part lookup
custom_preconds: Admin. Part P was inactive and is now reactivated.
custom_steps:
1. WO line → Add Part → search P
  2. Estimate → Add Part → search P
  3. New PO → part field → P
  4. Part sale → Add Part → P
  5. Save each with P
custom_expected:
1. P is offered
  2. P is offered
  3. P is offered (no inactive message)
  4. P is offered
  5. Each save succeeds; no "is inactive" refusal
